description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android Tic Tac Toe game with integrated card matching mini-game, handling UI interactions, game logic, AI moves, and settings persistence.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages the Tic Tac Toe game UI, game state, AI integration, and settings for the Android app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds UI components, loads settings, and sets up event handlers.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current state for configuration changes.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes pending callbacks to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: applySettingsToControls
methods.description: Updates UI controls based on loaded settings.

methods.name: updateModeUi
methods.description: Updates UI elements related to game mode and symbol selection.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state and UI for a new game.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles user tapping a cell to make a move.

methods.name: maybeTriggerAiTurn
methods.description: Triggers AI move after user turn if in computer mode.

methods.name: applyMove
methods.description: Applies a move to the game board, checks for win/draw, updates UI.

methods.name: endDraw
methods.description: Handles game draw scenario.

methods.name: lockBoardForAiThinking
methods.description: Disables the board during AI move calculation.

methods.name: unlockBoardAfterAiThinking
methods.description: Re-enables the board after AI move.

methods.name: lockBoard
methods.description: Disables all input when game ends.

methods.name: findWinner
methods.description: Checks all win lines for a winner.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Determines if the game is a draw.

methods.name: updatePlayerIndicator
methods.description: Updates UI to show current player.

methods.name: setBannerNeutral
methods.description: Displays neutral messages.

methods.name: setBannerWin
methods.description: Displays win message.

methods.name: setBannerDraw
methods.description: Displays draw message.

methods.name: applyMarkStyling
methods.description: Applies styling to a cell based on the mark.

methods.name: other
methods.description: Returns the opposite game symbol.
